olivia_k: Hey finance team — quick one. Hotel Central put a single line on the master folio labeled 'Airport transfer x3' for GBP 360. I paid my own room & transfer on my personal card and submitted the room. How should I claim the transfer since it's on the hotel's folio and was paid by the company card at checkout?

marcus_lead: @olivia_k we checked in together, I paid the hotel with the corpcard for the group's incidentals but you charged your room to your personal. The corpcard txn covers the master folio including the transfer.

travel-bot: Booking ID EVT-2245: Hotel Central (2026-03-05). Master folio 451200. Line items: Rooms (3), Conference fee, Airport transfer x3 GBP 360. Payment: corpcard ****4321 charged on 2026-03-06 for full folio.

finance_jordan: Thanks for the details. Because the corpcard paid the folio we can reclass the corpcard transaction to allocate the transfer to the appropriate employees instead of reimbursing you.

olivia_k: Great — what do you need from me to get it reallocated?

finance_jordan: Two things please: 1) a short note in your expense submission saying 'Airport transfer (Hotel Central folio 451200) — allocate to Olivia K; corpcard txn ****4321', and 2) manager sign-off confirming you took the transfer. A single Slack confirmation from @marcus_lead is sufficient. We'll post the reclass and expense will clear as a reimbursement to the corpcard holder (if any) or as a non-payroll allocation.

marcus_lead: Confirmed — Olivia used the transfer on arrival. Approved for allocation.

olivia_k: Should I still attach my boarding pass or a mileage log? The travel portal asked for proof of travel for transfers.

finance_jordan: Attach whatever proof you have (boarding pass or travel itinerary) — helpful but not mandatory for this reclass since the corpcard txn backs the folio. Note on VAT: since the supplier here is the hotel and the folio was paid on the corporate card, Redwood can reclaim VAT only if the supplier invoice lists VAT registration and the supplier matches the service (i.e., the hotel or the shuttle vendor). If the folio doesn't break out VAT per line or there's no supplier VAT id, we'll treat the allocation as non-reclaimable and code it to travel expense (no VAT credit).

olivia_k: Folio 451200 has VAT total but no supplier VAT ID per line. I'll attach the folio and my itinerary and submit the allocation note. Thanks!

travel-bot: Note added to booking EVT-2245: finance instructed reclassification of corpcard folio 451200; VAT treatment pending vendor invoice details.
